references.text: The use of fishing images to illustrate gathering or judgment is also found in the book of Habakkuk, where it speaks of gathering people.
Jesus calls his first disciples, who were fishermen, to become 'fishers of men,' which prepares for the theme of gathering people into God's kingdom.
Luke gives a detailed account of a miraculous catch of fish, which can be seen as a precursor to the idea of gathering people into God's kingdom.
Revelation contains images of an angel casting a large net into the sea to gather fish, an action that resembles the description in Matthew.
